purpose: Primary-source comparison of cavity BEM evidence and experimental benchmark requirements

conclusion.reason: The retrieved primary sources compare different geometries, closure models and observables. None establishes a universal permissible experimental cavity-length error.
conclusion.ourWaidScope: Nc128 first-half length differences of +12.52%, -9.06%, +11.41%, +4.03%, and width differences +2.84%, +2.90%, +2.18%, +0.80%, are model-to-digitized-experiment differences, not numerical residuals. Unmatched facility/closure physics remains.

papers.citation: Nouroozi, Pasandidehfard & Djavareshkian (2016), Mathematical Problems in Engineering, 1593849
papers.method: Fixed-length potential-based source/doublet-ring BEM; simple and reentrant-jet closure; axisymmetric and quasi-3D bodies
papers.geometry: Disk supercavity; blunt/hemispherical/conical head cylinders; quasi-3D elliptical head cylinder, not a hydrofoil

conditions.diskFigure6: PDFp7: Lc/D=5 gives sigma=.272; Lc/D=10 gives sigma=.149; jet length/Lc=.5
conditions.partialFigure10: PDFp8: sigma=.3, blunt/hemispherical/conical-head cylinders; conical half-angle40deg from PDFp4
conditions.quasi3D: PDFp9, section8.3: sigma=.2,.3; ellipse Rmax/Rmin=1.2; body20 times minor diameter; comparison to Fluent mixture model
conditions.CFDSpeeds: PDFp5 section7:20 to46.33m/s; no single common Re specified

papers.evidence: PDFp7 Figs7/8 compare disk cavity length and maximum diameter to analytical/experimental curves cited through Knapp et al. [2]. PDFp8 Fig10 compares body Cp to experimental headform measurements; simple closure produces closure-region overshoot, reduced by reentrant jet.

explicitMagnitude.quantity: Worst quasi-3D BEM cavity-length excess over 3D Fluent mixture-model result

papers.matchingLimits: Current image-disk cavity does not implement this paper's finite reentrant jet and partial-body wake. Neither the15% statement nor headform Cp is a matched hydrofoil error tolerance.

papers.citation: Fadaei Rodi, Kamali & Pasandidehfard (2024), Physics of Fluids36,103356
papers.method: Taguchi optimization; transient Ansys Fluent SST k-omega + VOF/HRIC and ventilated-cavity experiment, NOT BEM
papers.geometry: Optimized parabolic/rational-quadratic cavitator; diameter20mm, holder15mm diameter and355mm long; optimized incidence10deg
papers.conditions: PDFp10 (journalp9): U7.3m/s, Re164000, Fr16.5, CQ .06 to.125. PDFpp4-6: tunnel1000x100x200mm, dt1e-5s,825000cells. PDFp8 TableV:b1=.3,b2=.2,w=1.5,alpha10deg.
papers.evidence: PDFp8 Fig11 cavity photos and numerical interfaces; p9 Figs12/13 cavitation number and length; p10 Fig16 optimized-vs-disk comparison; pressure fluctuations also measured

explicitMagnitude.quantity: Improvement of optimized cavitator characteristics versus alternatives

papers.matchingLimits: No BEM accuracy threshold is established. Tilted ventilated geometry, gas flow, support rod, confined tunnel and unsteady closure do not match current zero-incidence ideal disk. Supporting data available from corresponding author on request, PDFp11.

papers.method: Nonlinear low-order potential BEM; fixed length/unknown sigma or fixed sigma/unknown length; zero normal velocity and specified cavity pressure; 3D extension uses thin-cavity treatment
papers.evidence: Official abstract explicitly reports 3D cavity-planform comparison to MIT cavitation-tunnel experiment. It does not establish that a 2D foil experimental benchmark passed. Original-author chapter9 pp11-13 Fig9.8 presents numerical sigma1.097 at L/c=.4 and zero-end-height formulation; geometry/settings require original figure matching.
conditionsMissing: Full paper's exact3D geometry/tunnel/case inputs and digitized experimental planforms were not recovered in this review.
2D Fig9.8 full geometry/detachment/recovery inputs must not be guessed.
papers.matchingLimits: Published qualitative agreement and numerical iteration convergence are not our hydrofoil experimental validation. Closed-sheet pressure recovery, detachment and physical admission must match.

papers.readStatus: Official primary abstract and indexed original-paper text at journalp570/573 verified; entire PDF unavailable after documented attempts. No unverified digitized BEM curve supplied.
papers.method: Panel method minimizing discretization-error vector; source/vortex strengths; closure/near-wake displacement thickness
papers.evidence: Journalp570 Fig9 compares t/c=.06, alpha2deg plano-convex cavity lengths to Uhlman-Jiang1977; Fig11 compares NACA16012 to Franc data. Source text says good agreement for short cavities L/c<.4; long-cavity reattachment assumption problematic. Official abstract emphasizes near-wake displacement thickness needed for satisfactory Lc/sigma.
papers.otherExplicitMagnitude: Journalp573: rounded trailing-edge cavity example lift changes less than +/-0.5% with chosen cavity length. This is model/wake sensitivity, not experiment error.
papers.matchingLimits: ReviewFig139 is this Fig9, not fresh independent evidence. Original-source K must be explicitly reconciled with sigma before using the review axis alpha/K. Do not replace actual parabolic foil by a circular-arc or NACA foil.

papers.method: Experiment plus linearized thin-foil source/vortex theory; not modern nonlinear BEM validation
papers.geometry: PDFp12/reportp2: 2D parabolic suction side and flat pressure side; t/c=.06; chord4in; span19.75in; vertical model in20in-square tunnel
papers.conditions: Figures2-6: alpha2,4,6,8,10deg. Per-point speed is varied and not tabulated; maximum facility speed9.1m/s is not the actual test speed. Cavity pressure read from tap atx/c~.17 when covered; otherwise vapor pressure inferred from temperature.
papers.evidence: PDFp24/reportp14 Fig3, alpha4deg, contains separate vapor-pressure and measured-cavity-pressure triangles. All five resolved open triangles digitized privately with bounded pixel provenance; four below L/c=.75 and one above retained. Figure2 alpha2deg is PDFp23/reportp13.
papers.sourceWarnings: PDFpp17-20/reportpp7-10: alpha2deg theories underpredict L/c; possible midchord cavity not represented. Good moderate-angle trend at4/6deg; instability for L/c>.75. Lift force was corrected using theoretical fully-wetted lift due poor lower-load-cell sensitivity; do not treat the corrected lift as wholly independent force validation.
papers.matchingLimits: Good candidate for a future restricted Lc(sigma) check, but custom geometry, pressure basis, detachment/closure, tunnel and Reynolds limitations must be explicit; current matched accepted solution does not yet exist.

papers.method: Nonlinear inviscid cavity analysis coupled to boundary-layer solver
papers.evidence: Official primary abstract: MIT Variable Pressure Water Tunnel velocities, detachment/reattachment for several sigma, momentum-flux force estimates; comparison with viscous-inviscid calculation
papers.matchingLimits: Plain inviscid kernel is not the reported coupled viscous method. Full case geometry/input tables not recovered; no numeric accuracy invented from abstract.

papers.citation: Phoemsapthawee, Leroux, Laurens & Deniset (2009), A Versatile Partial Sheet Cavitation Model, SMP2009
papers.method: Potential/BEM code with transpiration sheet-cavity model driven by noncavitating pressure; adaptive factor, not identical to full mixed free-boundary BEM
papers.hydrofoil2DCandidate: PDFp3 Fig2: measured/computed Cp for NACA66(mod)-312 a=.8, alpha6deg, Re=.75e6, sigmaV1.495; measurements from Leroux2003. Exact modified profile coordinates, tunnel and closure need matching.
papers.hydrofoil3DCandidate: PDFpp3-4: NACA0010, U6m/s, wall-mounted with strut; tunnel walls modeled; nominalalpha7deg, calculation corrected7.22deg; Fig5 cavitating normalized CL/CD trends.

explicitMagnitude.sourceInterpretation: Authors state lift difference less than6%; drag underprediction associated with omitted viscosity.

papers.matchingLimits: This supplies a specific BEM-related comparison, not a general4-13% allowance. Cavitating Fig5 is normalized by wet baseline, so baseline differences cannot be ignored.
